sync: kick out: hand to the sky
spec.prompt: Low-angle medium shot from behind and slightly to the side of the Lydian from reference image 1 (crested bronze helmet pushed up, braids, short beard, crimson tunic, bronze scale corselet, crimson lion shield), standing on a bare ridge against an empty, dark dusk sky; the only light is a dim twilight and an orange glow along the horizon, his silhouette crisp and readable. Action: 0-1.5 s he slowly raises his right arm overhead and presses his open palm flat against the sky, as if the sky were a sheet of glass just above him: the palm flattens and stops against the invisible surface; at 2 s he spreads his fingers and pushes harder; at 2.6 s he leans his head and shoulders forward and up, pressing his face toward the surface beside his hand, curious and awed. Camera static. Photoreal live-action cinema, crisp focus, high shutter speed with no motion blur. Clear air, no fog. Reference images are identity, costume and location references only: never show the grey studio, the turnaround layout or the inset panels. No text, no watermark.
spec.notes: Flammarion: the renderer makes the sky a membrane of lines where the palm presses.
